```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(spatstat)
library(stars)
library(gstat)
```

```{r}
Crash_IDW_2015 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2015_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2016 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2016_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2017 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2017_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2018 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2018_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2019 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2019_IDW.shp')
```

```{r}
tidy_2015 <- Crash_IDW_2015 %>%
  select(gid, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, vehicles, latitude, longitude, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2016 <- Crash_IDW_2016 %>%
  select(gid, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, vehicles, latitude, longitude, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2017 <- Crash_IDW_2017 %>%
  select(gid, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, vehicles, latitude, longitude, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2018 <- Crash_IDW_2018 %>%
  select(gid, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, vehicles, latitude, longitude, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2019 <- Crash_IDW_2019 %>%
  select(gid, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, vehicles, latitude, longitude, RASTERVALU)
```

```{r}
tidy_2015_2019 <- bind_rows(tidy_2015, tidy_2016, tidy_2017, tidy_2018, tidy_2019)
```

```{r}
combined_2015_2019 <- tidy_2015_2019 %>%
  rename(AADT_IDW = RASTERVALU)
```

```{r}
st_write(combined_2015_2019, './data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Data_2015_2019.shp')
```

2020-2024

```{r}
Crash_IDW_2020 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2020_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2021 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2021_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2022 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2022_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2023 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2023_IDW.shp')
Crash_IDW_2024 <- st_read('./data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Denver_2024_IDW.shp')
```

```{r}
Crash_IDW_2021 <- st_zm(Crash_IDW_2021, drop = TRUE, what = 'ZM')
Crash_IDW_2020 <- st_zm(Crash_IDW_2020, drop = TRUE, what = 'ZM')
```

```{r}
print(Crash_IDW_2021)
print(Crash_IDW_2020)
```

```{r}
tidy_2024 <- Crash_IDW_2024 %>%
  select(id, latitude, longitude, crashdate, crashtime, numbkilled, numbinjurd, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2023 <- Crash_IDW_2023 %>%
  select(id, latitude, longitude, crashdate, crashtime, numbkilled, numbinjurd, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2022 <- Crash_IDW_2022 %>%
  select(id, latitude, longitude, crashdate, crashtime, numbkilled, numbinjurd, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2021 <- Crash_IDW_2021 %>%
  select(id, latitude, longitude, crashdate, crashtime, numbkilled, numbinjurd, RASTERVALU)

tidy_2020 <- Crash_IDW_2020 %>%
  select(id, latitude, longitude, crashdate, crashtime, numbkilled, numbinjurd, RASTERVALU)
```

```{r}
tidy_2020_2024 <- bind_rows(tidy_2020, tidy_2021, tidy_2022, tidy_2023, tidy_2024)
```

```{r}
combined_2020_2024 <- tidy_2020_2024 %>%
  separate(crashdate, into = c('year', 'month', 'day'), sep ='-', remove = FALSE)%>%
  select(-crashdate)
```

```{r}
combined_2020_2024 <- combined_2020_2024 %>%
  mutate(hour = gsub(':', '', crashtime)) %>%
  mutate(hour = substr(hour, 1, nchar(hour) - 2))
```

```{r}
combined_2020_2024 <- combined_2020_2024 %>%
  rename(killed = numbkilled, injured = numbinjurd, AADT_IDW = RASTERVALU,
         orig_id = id) %>%
  relocate(orig_id, year, month, day, hour, killed, injured, latitude, longitude,
           AADT_IDW)
```

```{r}
combined_2020_2024 <- combined_2020_2024 %>%
  select(-crashtime)
```

```{r}
st_write(combined_2020_2024, './data/Crash_Data_IDW_Values/Crash_Data_2020_2024.shp')
```

```{r}
combined_2020_2024 <- combined_2020_2024 %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year), month = as.numeric(month), day = as.numeric(day))
```

```{r}
combined_2015_2019 <- combined_2015_2019 %>%
  rename(orig_id = gid)
```

```{r}
combined_2015_2019 <- combined_2015_2019 %>%
  select(-vehicles)
```

```{r}
Combined_2015_2024 <- bind_rows(combined_2015_2019, combined_2020_2024)
```

```{r}
Combined_2015_2024 <- Combined_2015_2024 %>%
  mutate(new_id = row_number())
```

```{r}
Combined_2015_2024 <- Combined_2015_2024 %>%
  relocate(new_id)
```

```{r}
st_write(Combined_2015_2024, './data/Final_Combined_Shapefile/Crash_Data_2015_2024.shp')
```
